_about: The nexus, as data rather than as code. Every number here is the number the browser build actually runs (check-world.py fails the build if they drift). An engine that can make a box, a torus, a light and a camera can rebuild this world from nothing but this file — which is the point: the frame travels, the destination re-derives.
_ports: Rebuilt in Roblox by roblox/WorldImporter.luau. What ports: realms, palettes, skylines, waypoints, portals, the crowd, the flight model, the director's shot list and cadence. What does NOT port is listed under `does_not_port`.

rng._about: A 31-bit LCG, seeded once, consumed in a fixed order so every engine builds the SAME world from the same seed. Order per realm: 70 x (height, colour-pick, width, depth, angle, radius), then 5 x (waypoint angle-spin once, radius, height), then 16 x (agent angle, radius, speed).

parity_vector._about: The first eight draws from default_seed. Any engine claiming to rebuild this world must reproduce these exactly; if it cannot, its realms will not match and the port is a different world wearing the same names. Both JS and Luau hold the intermediate as an IEEE-754 double and reduce mod 2^32 (ToInt32 / bit32.band), which is why they agree.

skyline._about: Spires. height is scaled by the realm's `tall`. One shared box per realm, scaled per instance.

waypoints._about: Five per realm on a ring, evenly spaced with a per-realm random spin, each marked by a torus the pilot flies through.

crowd._about: The others. They wander, and they look up when the craft comes over them.

flight._about: Six controls, and nothing else drives the craft. The autopilot writes into these same six.

director._about: The camera cuts; it does not glide. A shot holds its subject for the whole take.

identity._about: rapp/1. The logbook is an append-only frame chain; the counters are a projection of it.

does_not_port._about: Named honestly so a Roblox build does not pretend to have these.
does_not_port.MediaRecorder: Recording the composited program canvas to .webm has no Roblox equivalent. Roblox has its own capture; the burned-in lower third would have to be a Billboard/SurfaceGui.
does_not_port.localStorage frame chain: Would become a DataStore (server-authoritative) or a per-player attribute. Note that changes the trust model: the chain stops being the player's own browser-local record.
does_not_port.GitHub device-code auth: Roblox already knows who the player is; Heimdall's sign-in is redundant there. Do not ship an OAuth flow inside Roblox.
does_not_port.three.js Fog / MeshStandardMaterial: Map to Lighting.Atmosphere + FogEnd and to PBR Part materials; the look will differ and that is expected.
does_not_port.crypto.subtle SHA-256: Roblox has no WebCrypto. A frame chain there needs a Luau SHA-256 implementation or a server round-trip.
